İnqlab.definition:
İnqlab is changeable. He always likes to talk. He is attached to animals.

-Hello İnqlab, you love to walk more than anything

İzeltaş.definition: İzeltaş means quality and endurance. Best of best at the handtool business. Turkey’s first and biggest handtool manufacturer
İzeltaş.example: [You are] the İzeltaş of this job.

İnci.definition: an [amazing girl] who is [my friend] and who is really talented and [everyone] is very grateful for finding the chance to meet her
İnci.example: You [see] İnci? She is amazing again!
